purpose: How each runtime provides each abstract capability of a runtime-neutral agent behavior (RealityEngine_Machines schemas/agent-behavior.schema.json). A behavior grants capabilities; a renderer maps them here and fails on any capability its runtime cannot provide. 'endpoint' is the existing interface the tool wraps; 'implemented' says whether the tool wrapper exists today.

scopes.frame: Bound to one asset frame: the server holds only that frame's step capability (assetID frame isolation, CONTINUATIONS_APPROVAL_CHAIN.md).
scopes.instance: Bound to the universe the agent runs beside (instance registry, PE, engines).
scopes.external: Reaches a service outside the universe.

pod.write.endpoint: lifecycle /pod proxy, write under the pinned ETag (pod:write scope)

openclaw.mcp: gateway-wide: OpenClaw's mcp.servers bind to the gateway, not to one agent, so a frame-scoped server is shared by every agent (accepted deficiency, RealityEngine_CI#714). Frame-scoped capabilities render with that deficiency recorded.
openclaw.toolPolicy: a clone agent is allowed session_status only today (scripts/clone-agents.mjs); granted capabilities are recorded beside it for the gateway policy

acp.mcp: per session: ACP session/new takes the MCP servers for that session, so each frame-scoped server is started for one clone's session with that frame's capability only. Isolation by construction, which closes RealityEngine_CI#714.
acp.protocol: Agent Client Protocol (JSON-RPC over stdio): initialize, session/new {cwd, mcpServers}, session/prompt {sessionId, prompt}. Pin the protocol version when the runtime is chosen (v0.0.3).
